priorityList: Before combat, cast Seed of Corruption to apply Wither to the pack immediately.
Cast Seed of Corruption if Wither is missing or needs refreshing on the primary target.
Maintain Agony on up to 5 targets, prioritizing those with the lowest remaining duration.
Cast Dark Harvest, Summon Darkglare, and Malevolence together as your primary burst window.
If Sow the Seeds is talented, use Seed of Corruption as your primary Soul Shard spender in AoE.
If Sow the Seeds is not talented, spend Soul Shards on Unstable Affliction during cooldowns or when at 5 shards.
In 2-target cleave, maintain Wither and Agony on both targets, then use Unstable Affliction as your primary spender.
Spend Shard Instability procs on Unstable Affliction immediately.
Use Nightfall procs on Seed of Corruption if Nocturnal Yield is talented and you are in AoE.
If Nightfall reaches maximum stacks or is about to expire, use it on Shadow Bolt, Drain Soul, or Malefic Grasp.
If talented, channel Malefic Grasp as your filler while Darkglare is active to maximize its benefit.
Refresh Wither or Agony manually if they are within pandemic range (less than 5 seconds remaining) and Seed of Corruption won't cover them.
Use Shadow Bolt or Drain Soul as your standard filler when no other priorities are met.
In the final seconds of a fight, dump remaining Soul Shards into Unstable Affliction.
